✨ Join & Chill with Our 24/7 Continuous Stream

Step into your personal auditory haven. Whether you are hacking on code late at night, grinding through intensive study sessions, reading your favorite book, or letting go of daily stress for deep sleep—our autonomous 24/7 stream is built to be your reliable companion.

Every single track is crafted with Studio HD audio mastering, free of harsh vocal drops or jarring advertisements. We continuously cycle through 16 thematic moods with relaxing visual loops to match the exact vibe you need.

Every 3 hours, our autonomous broadcast transitions seamlessly into a new genre mood.

⚙️ Autonomous Streaming Architecture

Our stream is powered by an autonomous Python streamer running 24/7 on a dedicated Linux VPS node in Jakarta. It dynamically manages YouTube broadcast sessions, generates dynamic HD visual thumbnails via FFmpeg, and auto-recovers from any network drops without human intervention.

🎵 100% Royalty-Free & Creator Friendly

Every track featured in our live stream and web library is completely safe to use for background audio in your live streams, podcasts, study vlogs, and creative projects without fear of copyright strikes.

About Otakai Music

音界 • Sound Realm Sanctuary

Otakai Music is an autonomous 24/7 lofi & ambient streaming sanctuary engineered to accompany your daily workflow—whether you are coding, studying, reading, or winding down for deep sleep.

📂 2,000+ Track Library: Mastered in pristine Studio HD audio without distracting vocal cuts.
🌧️ 16 Aesthetic Mood Rotations: From Deep Sleep and Morning Coffee to Coding Flow State and Frieren Fantasy.
🎧 Royalty-Free: Stream anytime seamlessly on desktop and mobile browsers.

🎯 Our Purpose

Our core mission at Otakai Music is to provide a distraction-free audio space:

🎯 1. Boost Focus & Deep Flow: Support deep-work sessions with downtempo rhythms (70–85 BPM) designed to reduce cognitive stress.
💤 2. Sleep & Rest Relief: Incorporating Delta frequencies and 528Hz Solfeggio tones for rest and calm.
🌐 3. Seamless Accessible Streaming: Choose specific albums or enjoy our autonomous 24/7 continuous stream.
